result.summary: Closed out ISS-0048 per WF-03 Step 5. Updated docs/issues/ISS-0048.yaml: status: resolved, resolved_in_run: WF03-ISS0048-20260818, resolved_at: 2026-08-18T23:02:37Z, plus a resolution_note recording the scope shift discovered during diagnosis (steps 01-04c of this run): the originally-suspected affected_files (5 identity/role_registry test files) were exonerated -- each already had correct on_exit DROP SCHEMA ordering -- and the actual root cause was Letflow.SandboxPool (lib/letflow/sandbox_pool.ex) disclosing but never implementing an owner-crash/kill reaper, so a test process that died abnormally (crash/kill/timeout) before its on_exit ran left its tenant/sandbox schema permanently orphaned instead of reclaimed. Fixed by implementing the missing owner-monitor extension in SandboxPool, proven via a fail-then-pass regression test (test/letflow/sandbox_pool_test.exs, spec test/specs/ISS-0048.md) and confirmed clean against the full suite (5 properties, 874 tests, 0 failures, per step-04c-test-runner.json). The resolution_note also flags an open, unresolved observation: a separately-noted drop of the orphaned-schema population from 69 to 0 within ~10h with no identified cause -- explicitly not explained or resolved by this fix, called out for anyone investigating a future recurrence. Closed GitHub issue #198 via `gh issue close 198 --comment ...` referencing this run and the regression test path. Committed docs/issues/ISS-0048.yaml (commit afe48d9) and pushed to origin/feature/WF03-ISS0048-20260818.
